title: ittcsecscan configuration file
description: Operator configuration for ittcsecscan. The file never holds credentials: cloud access always comes from the provider's native credential chain. Unknown keys are rejected so that typos and misplaced secrets fail loudly instead of being ignored.

schema_version.description: Version of this configuration schema. Only 1 is defined.

log.description: Diagnostic logging. Logs are written to stderr and are always redacted.

data_dir.description: Absolute path of the local data directory (store, snapshots, reports). Defaults to the platform's per-user application data directory.

master_key_file.description: Absolute path of the operator's passphrase-wrapped master-key file (ADR-0015). The path only, never the key. Must lie outside data_dir. Empty means no key file is configured.
